name: KeyCorp
description: KeyCorp is the holding company for KeyBank, a regional bank with 940 branches and 1,120 ATMs in 15 states. It takes deposits (about $146 billion across its segments) and lends (mostly commercial loans, about $105 billion of loans on average in 2025), earning net interest income of $4.6 billion, plus fees from wealth management, investment banking and debt placement, commercial mortgage servicing, cards and deposit service charges (2025 noninterest income $2.8 billion). Its commercial side is the larger profit engine: the Commercial Bank earned $1,447M against the Consumer Bank's $527M. Scotiabank owns about 14.9 percent of its shares following a $2.8 billion investment completed in 2024. Reported 2025 results have no comparable year because in Q4 2024 Key sold securities at a $1.86 billion loss to reposition its balance sheet.

employees.note: 17,883 full-time and part-time employees (average 17,226 full-time equivalents in 2025).

businessLines.name: Consumer Bank
businessLines.how: Earns the spread between what it charges on mortgages, home equity and consumer loans and what it pays on retail and small-business deposits (net interest income), plus deposit service charges, card fees and wealth fees from its branch network.

businessLines.name: Commercial Bank
businessLines.how: Lends to businesses (commercial and industrial, commercial real estate) and earns the interest spread, plus fees from advising on and placing debt and equity, servicing commercial mortgages for investors, payments and treasury services, and leasing.

brands.name: KeyBank
brands.note: Principal bank subsidiary: 940 full-service branches and 1,120 ATMs in 15 states at 2025-12-31
